operations.name: decision.create

consequences_markdown.description: What follows from the decision (Markdown text).

operations.description: Rename a zone or move it. A rename (no parent_id) writes the name only. parent_id moves the zone with its contents: absent leaves it where it is; null moves it to the desk root.

operations.completion: synchronous; zone.read returns the new state; one desk_changed frame (kind directory, op update) on the hub bus

admission.condition: parent_id is present (null included): the zone moves with its contents. A rename alone (no parent_id) is exempt and writes the name only (PHILO-7-01 rename repair).
